# uai-logo



<!-- Auto Generated Below -->


## Overview

Brand logo from the versioned asset catalog in blip-tokens. Set the host width to control its size;
the SVG keeps the aspect ratio from its viewBox. Use aria-label for a meaningful logo, or omit it when decorative.

## Properties

| Property    | Attribute    | Description                                                                | Type     | Default     |
| ----------- | ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `ariaLabel` | `aria-label` | Accessible name for a meaningful logo. Without it, the logo is decorative. | `string` | `null`      |
| `dataTest`  | `data-test`  | Value forwarded to the logo SVG container's data-test attribute.           | `string` | `undefined` |
| `name`      | `name`       | Logo name as listed in the blip-tokens asset catalog.                      | `string` | `undefined` |


## Shadow Parts

| Part      | Description                          |
| --------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `"asset"` | The element containing the logo SVG. |
